mapper.select: select d.id, d.shop_code, d.detailcode, d.shipcode, d.orderdetailcode, d.goodscode, d.goodsname, d.spec, d.unit, d.qty, d.sourcecode, d.remark, g.batchstrategy, g.costcalculation from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatchdetail_${tableSuffix} d left join sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g on g.shop_code = d.shop_code and g.goodscode = d.goodscode where d.shop_code = #{shopCode} and d.shipcode = #{shipCode} order by d.detailcode

select d.shop_code, d.orderdetailcode, d.goodscode, sum(d.qty) as qty from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatchdetail_${tableSuffix} d join sdsorder.u_f_shipbatch_${tableSuffix} b on b.shop_code = d.shop_code and b.shipcode = d.shipcode where d.shop_code = #{shopCode} and b.ordercode in #{code} and b.status in ('待确认', '已提交仓库', '已打印备货单', '备货完成', '已录入快递单号', '已打印快递单号') group by d.shop_code, d.orderdetailcode, d.goodscode
mapper.insert:
insert into sdsorder.u_f_shipbatchdetail_${tableSuffix} (shop_code, detailcode, shipcode, orderdetailcode, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, qty, sourcecode, remark) values
(#{item.shopCode}, #{item.detailCode}, #{item.shipCode}, #{item.orderDetailCode}, #{item.goodsCode}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.qty}, #{item.sourceCode}, #{item.remark})
mapper.delete: delete from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatchdetail_${tableSuffix} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and shipcode = #{shipCode}
delete from sdsorder.u_f_shipbatchdetail_${tableSuffix} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and detailcode = #{detailCode}
